scope: Direct runtime dependencies declared in pyproject.toml. Transitive dependencies are resolved at install time and ship their own license texts.

components.name: pylibseekdb
components.text_location: none in 1.3.0; pylibseekdb/licenses/ and pylibseekdb-<version>.dist-info/licenses/ in >=1.4.1
components.notes: The 1.3.0 wheel ships no license text. The complete engine and bindings bundle ships under pylibseekdb/licenses/ from 1.4.1 (oceanbase/seekdb-bindings#95).
components.redistribution: Retain the complete pylibseekdb/licenses/ bundle shipped in the pylibseekdb wheel (>=1.4.1), including the engine inventory and license texts.

components.name: PyMySQL
components.redistribution: Retain the license text from the resolved pymysql distribution.

components.name: MNN
components.text_location: no license file in the 3.6.1 wheel; upstream https://github.com/alibaba/MNN/blob/master/LICENSE
components.notes: The resolved wheel bundles no license text; take it from the upstream repository.
components.redistribution: Retain the upstream MNN license text; the resolved wheel does not bundle one.

components.name: tokenizers
components.text_location: no license file in the 0.22.2 wheel; upstream https://github.com/huggingface/tokenizers/blob/main/LICENSE
components.notes: The resolved wheel bundles no license text; take it from the upstream repository.
components.redistribution: Retain the upstream tokenizers license text; the resolved wheel does not bundle one.

components.name: httpx
components.redistribution: Retain the license text from the resolved httpx distribution.

components.name: tqdm
components.notes: The locked wheel stores the license at LICENCE, not under licenses/.
components.redistribution: Retain the MPL-2.0 and MIT texts from the resolved tqdm distribution (dist-info/LICENCE).

components.name: tenacity
components.redistribution: Retain the license text from the resolved tenacity distribution.

components.name: numpy
components.license: BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0 (core only)
components.notes: The expression covers the numpy core without vendored libraries. The 2.4.2 Linux wheels bundle OpenBLAS (BSD-3-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause-Attribution), libgfortran (GPL-3.0-with-GCC-exception) and libquadmath (LGPL-2.1-or-later) under numpy.libs/; their texts are not in dist-info/licenses/.
components.redistribution: Retain the core license texts. If you redistribute the Linux wheels, also satisfy the vendored library licenses, including the LGPL-2.1 section 6 source conditions for libquadmath.
